'''This unidentified [[Squib/Legends|Squib]]''' was a [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi Apprentice]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the [[Swarm War]] this individual was training to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]]. When [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] visited the academy, the apprentice was partaking in a game of [[Skorch]].
